name: What a Kitchen Backsplash Costs Installed in Kenmore
title-tag: Kitchen Backsplash Installation Cost | Kenmore, WA
meta-description: What a kitchen backsplash costs installed in Kenmore: $14-$26/sq ft, why small jobs run high per foot, and how outlets and edge trim decide the real number.
post-summary: January 19, 2027 · A typical Kenmore backsplash is 30-50 sq ft, which prices most jobs between roughly $560 and $1,300 installed — expensive per foot, modest in total. Here is why the arithmetic works that way, why outlets and edges are the actual job, and how to read the spread between three quotes for the same wall.
